news.title: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited (BSE:531035) agreed to acquire an unknown minority stake in Ebix Payment Services Pvt Ltd. for INR 1.8 billion.
news.body: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited (BSE:531035) agreed to acquire an unknown minority stake in Ebix Payment Services Pvt Ltd. for INR 1.8 billion on April 14, 2026. A cash consideration of INR 1.8 billion will be paid by Eraaya Lifespaces Limited. As part of consideration, INR 1.8 billion is paid towards common equity of Ebix Payment Services Pvt Ltd. Eraaya Lifespaces Limited owns 80% of  Ebix Payment Services through its subsidiary Ebix, Inc. With this transaction the Company has execute a negotiated framework for the complete buyout of minority shareholding in Ebix Payment Services Private Limited.

news.title: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 116.247144 million in funding from Melanie Lane Capital Management LLC, Watch Hill Capital LLC
news.body: Eraaya Lifespaces Limited announced a private placement of 2,860,412 common shares at a price of INR 40.64 per share for gross proceeds of INR 116,247,143.68 on November 17, 2025. The securities will be issued on preferential basis. The transaction has been approved by the board of directors of the company. The transaction included participation from new investors Melanie Lane Partners Series Fund, Lp Melanie Lane Partners Series One, a fund managed by Melanie Lane Capital Management LLC for 1,650,172 shares; and Watch Hill Capital LLC for 1,210,240 shares.
